findings.title: Step 5b's weaponsOffline and LAUNCH refusal bring back `rooms[Weapons] ≥ 2` as a crew gate, which Part i removed; feelIiModels breaks and is not in any run list
findings.claim: Step 5b's new `weaponsOffline` starts with `sys.rooms[Room.Weapons] >= 2 ||`. Its `refusal` rewrite also keeps `if (sys.rooms[Room.Weapons] >= 2) return 'WEAPONS OFFLINE';` for LAUNCH. Part i makes the crew's gates bars-only: crew `laserOffline` is `barrelShots === 0`, and crew `canLaunch` is `weaponBars(Torpedo) >= 1`. Part i's fallout rule also names `rooms[Weapons] ≥ 2` as a replaced rule. So with the Weapons room at level 2 and bars still on a weapon, the console reads WEAPONS OFFLINE and refuses LAUNCH while the sim fires and launches. The changed FIRE wording also breaks the existing `tests/feelIiModels.test.ts`, which Step 6 does not run. That file's L213 expects FIRE `null` at round start, but Part ii now gives 'BEAM UNPOWERED' because the beam starts dark. L218 expects WEAPONS OFFLINE for FIRE with `rooms=2`, but FIRE now turns only on the beam's bars. L233-236 asserts `refusal(launch) === null` exactly when `canLaunch` is true, over `rooms` 0..2, and the kept rooms check breaks that.
findings.evidence: plan L2026-2029 (`weaponsOffline` with `sys.rooms[Room.Weapons] >= 2 ||`), L2062-2065 (the rooms≥2 LAUNCH line kept), L2101-2102 (Step 6 run list, no feelIiModels); Part i plan L49 (kind (a) lists '`rooms[Weapons] ≥ 2` as the crew's laser gate'), L2771-2774 (crew canLaunch: `weaponBars(s, WeaponSlot.Torpedo) >= 1`), L2784-2786 (crew laserOffline: bars only), L3037 (situationModel belongs to Part ii); tests/feelIiModels.test.ts:213, :218, :233-237; src/renderer/src/render/duel/situationModel.ts:189.
findings.why: The console gives reasons the sim doesn't act on (the 'never a dead click' rule that feelIiModels guards). The failures first show up in Task 10's full suite, and no recipe there covers them.
findings.fix: Drop `sys.rooms[Room.Weapons] >= 2 ||` from `weaponsOffline`. In `refusal`, delete the kept rooms≥2 LAUNCH line so the torpedo-bars line matches `canLaunch`. Add `tests/feelIiModels.test.ts` to Step 6's run, with the updates spelled out: at L213 set `sys.weaponPower[1] = 1` (beam powered) before asserting `null`, or expect 'BEAM UNPOWERED'; at L218 zero `weaponPower` in place of `rooms[Weapons] = 2` to get WEAPONS OFFLINE; L236 then holds. Name the file in the Step 11 git add.

findings.title: Step 5b's new test leaves the seed and the hx/hy check to execution
findings.claim: The test hand-places the Hunter 200 ahead. The plan then says 'Check `hx` and `hy` against direction.ts', and if an asteroid blocks the line at seed 5, to 'try seeds 6 to 9'. Both are checks deferred to execution. The first isn't needed: `hx` and `hy` exist at direction.ts:6-7.
findings.why: Under this review's rules, a check left to execution is a defect. It is small here.
findings.fix: Delete the hx/hy check. Make the line of sight certain in the test instead of searching seeds: deactivate the asteroids before the assertions, or assert `lineOfSight(t, …)` true as a precondition at a fixed seed the author has checked.
